config.ranking: softplus(1+max_wrong_logit-correct_logit), accepted training digits only, averaged over generated prefixes
config.gradient: hard generated codes forward; straight-through soft code embeddings backward
config.training_trigger: validation oracle L2/L3/all raw digit accuracy exceeds generated by at least .005 for either frozen checkpoint; no test selection
config.oracle: observed acoustic tokenizer codes, not digit labels; diagnostic only
